shortDescription: India's Adani Group will invest 1 trillion rupees ($10.43 billion) in West Bengal by 2035, Chairman Gautam Adani said on Thursday, expanding its footprint across sectors ranging from power generation and logistics to hyperscale data centers.($1 = 95.8850 Indian rupees)
